assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: premium creative-agency website hero background, wide landscape cinematic architectural composition. Create an original artistic city of office buildings, near photorealistic architectural visualization but distinctly sculptural and authored. A signature central skyscraper on the RIGHT half has an elegant gently twisting elliptical glass body, staggered white ceramic terraces, aluminum ribs, a split crown and warm old-gold metal detailing. Surrounding creative skyline includes stepped monoliths, a sweeping arch and asymmetric rounded office towers, never a generic collection of rectangular boxes. Ground-level grand glass entrance, realistic deep lobby, polished black stone plaza and warm dark coffee-brown mineral pavement, subtle wet reflections, fine atmospheric depth. Main palette WHITE, brushed ALUMINUM, BLACK, DARK COFFEE BROWN, GLASS and restrained OLD GOLD. Dawn light glowing along edges against a rich charcoal sky; tactile stone, real seams and coherent engineering. Large calm darker negative space on LEFT for editorial website text; street viewpoint, central entrance visible, architecture occupies center/right. High-end art directed architectural model photography, sophisticated, vibrant contrast and refined materials. No people, no words, no logos, no signage text, no watermarks, no neon, no turquoise city, no generic cyberpunk. Landscape 16:9.
